abstract: The purpose of this study was to examine the pathology of all germ cell tumours of the testis diagnosed in Iceland 1955-2002. A total of 214 patients were included in the study. The current age-standardized incidence was found to be 6.1 per 100,000 and had increased almost fourfold during the study period. Seminoma was diagnosed in 55% of cases. Non-seminomas were diagnosed in 45%, and these were further classified as mixed germ cell tumours (33%), embryonal carcinoma (8%), teratoma (3%), and yolk sac tumour (n=1). The mean age at diagnosis was significantly higher for the seminomas than the non-seminomas (38 years versus 29 years) (p<0.001) and the non-seminomas were diagnosed at a significantly higher stage than the seminomas (p<0.001). Thus, in seminoma patients the tumour was localized to the testis (stage I) in 81% of cases, in 17% of patients the tumour had spread to the lymph nodes (stage II or III), and only 2% had extranodal metastasis at diagnosis (stage IV). In contrast, in the non-seminoma patients, the tumours were found to be stage I in 56%, stage II or III in 24%, and stage IV in 20% of cases. No significant difference in staging was found between non-seminoma subtypes. Identification of necrosis or vascular invasion was significantly associated with metastatic disease at diagnosis (p=0.002). During the study period a significant increase in stage I tumours was found as well as a decrease in the size of the tumours.
abstract_ja: 本研究の目的は、1955〜2002年にアイスランドで診断されたすべての精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病理像を検討することであった。対象は214例であった。年齢調整罹患率は10万人あたり6.1で、研究期間中にほぼ4倍に増加していた。セミノーマは55%に診断された。非セミノーマは45%で、混合型胚細胞腫瘍（33%）、胎児性癌（8%）、奇形腫（3%）、卵黄嚢腫瘍（1例）に分類された。セミノーマの診断時平均年齢は非セミノーマより有意に高かった（38歳対29歳）（p<0.001）。非セミノーマは、セミノーマより有意に高い病期で診断された（p<0.001）。セミノーマ患者では、81%が精巣に限局する病期I、17%がリンパ節転移を伴う病期IIまたはIII、2%が診断時に節外転移を有する病期IVであった。非セミノーマ患者では、病期Iが56%、病期IIまたはIIIが24%、病期IVが20%であった。非セミノーマの組織型間で病期分類に有意差は認められなかった。壊死や血管浸潤の所見は、診断時の転移性疾患と有意に関連していた（p=0.002）。研究期間中、病期Iの腫瘍が有意に増加し、腫瘍径は縮小していた。
